title: Hearth & Fang ready for you to become the next mighty ruler!
author: proudfather1986
selftext:
I posted yesterday but had no video or screenshots to assist with showing off what exactly it is. You can play the full game and find photos on https://nerdhouse1986.itch.io/hearthfang 

Claude Opus 5.5 was used for coding and models. I added royalty free music from available web searches. Campaign, Skirmishes, and Multiplayer with your friends is ready to go! Please feel free to give it a go and tell me what you think. All feedback is greatly welcomed and appreciated! Thank you to r/aigamedev for being so awesome and supportive of AI created content. It’s our future and has already been a huge part of our past. Might as well embrace it.
